canvas_id.desc: Encoded ID of the canvas whose content to replace.

channel.desc: ID of the agent session channel the canvas is attached to.

content.desc: The full new canvas content as markdown. The server diffs this against the current content and applies only the changed sections.

desc: Replace the full markdown content of a plan canvas attached to a code channel.

errors.canvas_content_fetch_failed: The canvas's current content could not be read to compute the diff.
errors.canvas_content_update_failed: The canvas content could not be updated.
errors.canvas_not_found: The specified canvas\_id does not correspond to a canvas you can access.
errors.channel_not_found: The specified channel does not correspond to a valid channel.
errors.content_too_large: The provided content exceeds the maximum canvas size.
errors.not_agent_channel: The specified channel is not an agent session channel.
errors.not_authorized: The caller is not an authorized agent bot for this channel.
errors.too_many_sections: The provided content or the existing canvas has too many sections to diff. Reduce the number of distinct blocks (paragraphs, headings, code fences) in the document.
